exposure: socio-demographic factors (rural background, illiteracy, complex family structures, large family size, low income)
cohort: 100 Pakistani women whose neonates were admitted to the special care baby unit (SCBU) nursery.
finding: A broad spectrum of epidemiological and dietary factors, including rural background, illiteracy, large family size, low income, short interpregnancy interval, nutritional deficiencies, and maternal infections, contributed to low birth weight and preterm births.
